interface.shortDescription: Build model-powered behavior: agents, retrieval, evals, and guardrails
interface.longDescription: A faceted router for building the model-powered behavior of a product across chat, autonomous-agent, RAG, batch, and multi-agent systems — provider- and language-agnostic. Ten primary jobs (model selection & routing, prompt/context engineering, structured outputs, tools/MCP, agent construction, retrieval/RAG, memory, evaluation, guardrails, cost/observability) reshaped by five deployment surfaces. Evaluation is the flagship. The through-line is verify-and-subtract, not just assemble: prune the harness, budget tokens, decompose the judge, distrust benchmarks, prove retrieval, and know when not to multi-agent. Anti-staleness is enforced — every model, price, version, and spec fact is date-stamped and re-verified against the live source.
defaultPrompt: Use $ai to add login-with-Google and build the agent that answers questions over our docs.
Use $ai to write evals and an LLM judge for our support assistant.
Use $ai to pick and route between models to cut our token cost.
